quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #10
										  					
  

20 Questions • Passing Score 16

questions.question: What does an arrow painted on the pavement mean?

options.text: Drivers in the correct lane may make the movement shown by the arrow if they want to.
Drivers in the correct lane must make the movement shown by the arrow only if traffic lights are not working.
Drivers in the correct lane must always stop completely before making the movement shown by the arrow.
Drivers in the correct lane must make the movement shown by the arrow while following traffic signals.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drivers in the correct lane must make the movement shown by the arrow while following traffic signals.
questions.explanation: An arrow painted on the pavement in a traffic lane tells drivers they must move in the direction shown by the arrow. Always follow traffic signs and signals before moving in the direction the arrow shows.

questions.question: What does a solid white line down the center of a two-lane road mean?

options.text: Traffic moves in opposite directions and drivers cannot pass.
Traffic moves in opposite directions and drivers can pass when safe.
Traffic moves in the same direction and drivers cannot pass.
Traffic moves in the same direction and drivers can pass when safe.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic moves in the same direction and drivers cannot pass.
questions.explanation: White lines separate traffic moving in the same direction. A solid white line means drivers cannot pass.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A crossroad is ahead. Watch for traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: A crossroad is ahead. Watch for traffic.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a crossroad is ahead.

questions.question: What should you do while backing up?

options.text: Open your door to see if it is safe.
Turn your head and look through the rear window.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn your head and look through the rear window.
questions.explanation: Always check behind your vehicle before backing up. Children and small objects are hard to see from the driver's seat. Turn your head to look through the rear window while backing. Do not rely only on mirrors or sensors.

questions.question: Complete this sentence: ____ limit your concentration, perception, judgment, and memory.

options.text: Only a blood alcohol level higher than the legal limit can
Even the smallest amount of alcohol can
Only a blood alcohol level higher than 0.05 percent can

questions.correctAnswerText: Even the smallest amount of alcohol can
questions.explanation: Even a small amount of alcohol reduces your concentration, perception, judgment, and memory. Your driving skills will suffer. No one can drink and drive safely.

questions.question: What is distracted driving?

options.text: Just as safe as normal driving.

questions.correctAnswerText: Extremely dangerous.
questions.explanation: Distracted driving is extremely dangerous. It puts you, your passengers, pedestrians, cyclists, and other drivers at risk. Paying full attention to driving helps prevent crashes.

questions.question: What must a driver do when approaching a flashing red traffic signal?
questions.correctAnswerText: Stop before entering the intersection.
questions.explanation: A flashing red light means you must stop. Yield to traffic and pedestrians. Go only when it is safe. At a railroad crossing, a flashing red light means a train is coming. Yield to the train and go only when the lights stop flashing and warning devices turn off.

questions.question: What does an orange triangle with red borders on the back of a vehicle mean?

options.text: The vehicle is a school bus.

questions.correctAnswerText: The vehicle is moving slowly.
questions.explanation: An orange triangle with red borders shows that a vehicle is moving slowly. Drivers near this vehicle should not expect it to go faster than 25 mph.

questions.question: What is important to do before turning left?

options.text: Swing to the right side of your lane.
Wait until oncoming traffic has a red light.

questions.correctAnswerText: Yield to oncoming vehicles.
questions.explanation: When turning left at a traffic signal, you must let pedestrians and oncoming traffic pass first.

questions.question: What should you do if there is an oncoming car to your left and a bicyclist to your right?

options.text: Let the car pass and then pass the bike.

questions.correctAnswerText: Let the car pass and then pass the bike.
questions.explanation: When there are multiple hazards on the road, handle one at a time. Do not try to squeeze between an oncoming car and a bicyclist at the same time. Let the car pass first, then pass the bicyclist.

questions.question: If an aggressive driver cuts you off, what should you do?

options.text: Stay calm and move out of their way.
Flash your lights to show the driver they are wrong.
Do something to get back at the aggressive driver.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stay calm and move out of their way.
questions.explanation: If an aggressive driver cuts you off, stay calm and get away from them. Trying to get back at them makes the situation more dangerous.

questions.question: What do round signs warn you about?
questions.correctAnswerText: Railroad crossings ahead.
questions.explanation: Round signs warn you that a railroad crossing is coming. Be extra careful when you see this sign.

questions.question: An emergency vehicle with a siren is approaching. What must you do?

options.text: Slow down and drive with caution.
Drive to the nearest intersection and stop.
Pull to the side of the road and stop, away from any intersection.

questions.correctAnswerText: Pull to the side of the road and stop, away from any intersection.
questions.explanation: When an emergency vehicle with a siren approaches, you must pull to the side of the road and stop. Stay stopped until the vehicle passes.

questions.question: How should small children ride in a vehicle?

options.text: A strong adult can safely hold them.
They are safe standing on the floor in the back.
They won't get hurt in an accident because they are small.
They must never stand in the vehicle.

questions.correctAnswerText: They must never stand in the vehicle.
questions.explanation: Children need special car seats. No adult is strong enough to hold a child safely during an accident or sudden stop. Always use a proper seat for every child in the vehicle.

questions.question: What do work zone signs mean?

options.text: You must stop and back up immediately.
Drive faster to leave the work zone.

questions.correctAnswerText: Driving conditions are not ideal.
questions.explanation: Work zone signs are orange and show that work is happening on or near the road. Drive with extra caution when you see these signs.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: Keep right.
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers to stay in the right lane to avoid a hazard ahead.

questions.question: At what blood alcohol concentration (BAC) are you considered to be driving under the influence?
questions.correctAnswerText: 0.08 percent.
questions.explanation: If your blood alcohol concentration (BAC) is 0.08 percent or higher, you are driving under the influence. This is illegal and dangerous.

questions.question: If you stop at a railroad crossing with more than one track, when should you go?

options.text: When you can see clearly down all tracks.
Stop on the first track and watch for another train.
As soon as the train passes.

questions.correctAnswerText: When you can see clearly down all tracks.
questions.explanation: At a railroad crossing with more than one track, wait until you can see clearly down all tracks before moving. Another train may be coming.

questions.question: If another car is about to hit you, what should you do?
questions.correctAnswerText: Sound your horn.
questions.explanation: Use your horn to warn other drivers or pedestrians. If you think another car is about to hit you, sound your horn.

questions.question: If your vehicle starts to skid, what should you do?

options.text: Turn the wheel too far the other way.
Turn your wheel in the direction of the skid.
Let go of the steering wheel.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn your wheel in the direction of the skid.
questions.explanation: If your vehicle skids, stay calm and steer in the direction of the skid.
